references.text: The burnt offering shall be a bull from the herd, an animal without defect, to be accepted on behalf of the Lord.
The burnt offering may also come from the flock, either sheep or goats, a male without defect.
Instructions for offering a bull and a ram as a burnt offering to the Lord.
The same offering given by Nahshon son of Amminadab, serving as a pattern for the gifts of all the tribal leaders.
An identical burnt offering brought by Netanel son of Zuar from the tribe of Issachar.
An identical burnt offering brought by Eliab son of Helon from the tribe of Zebulun.
Regulations for burnt offerings at the new moon: bulls, rams, and lambs as an offering to the Lord.
Burnt offerings on the Sabbath day: a bull, a ram, and a one-year-old lamb.
